report.measurement_period: Sensor summaries from the same completed 60-second interval.
report.target: At least one expert-annotated apnea/hypopnea second in that interval; not person-level diagnosis.

threshold_selection.method: Positive-score quantile from patient-separated out-of-fold training predictions.
threshold_selection.note: Target recall is a development objective, not a guaranteed clinical or evaluation sensitivity.

report.model_selection: Inner patient-group CV maximizes balanced accuracy; outer validation refits tuning and threshold.

limitations: Only 30 stroke-unit patients; samples within a patient are correlated.
Actual sleep duration, age, BMI, and steps are not jointly available in this file.
No synthetic clinical fields or cross-dataset row joins were used.
Window-level scores cannot confirm or exclude whether a person has sleep apnea.
